invariants.description: C_O2_a is exactly C_O2_a0, multiplied by C_O2_multiplier inside [t_start_C_O2, t_end_C_O2]
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(C_O2_a - np.where((t < t_start_C_O2) | (t > t_end_C_O2), C_O2_a0, C_O2_a0*C_O2_multiplier))) <= 1e-12

invariants.description: C_CO2_a is exactly C_CO2_a0, multiplied by C_CO2_multiplier inside [t_start_C_CO2, t_end_C_CO2]
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(C_CO2_a - np.where((t < t_start_C_CO2) | (t > t_end_C_CO2), C_CO2_a0, C_CO2_a0*C_CO2_multiplier))) <= 1e-12

invariants.description: dot_C_CO2_a is identically zero (as written; see review: it ignores the step in C_CO2_a)
contents are non-negative volume fractions below 1 (mL gas per mL blood)

bc_sweep.rationale: Arterial O2 contents from severe hypoxaemia to normal (0.10-0.22 mL/mL), CO2 contents 0.40-0.60 mL/mL (hypo- to hypercapnia); multipliers from strong hypoxia (×0.5) to mild hyperoxia, and ×0.8-1.3 for CO2; step windows anywhere in the 60 s run. Multiplied values stay below 1 (volume fraction).

baseline.reason: prescribed input (arterial gas contents); its values are sourced constants. Validation belongs to the chemoreceptor model it drives.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: prescribed input (arterial gas contents); its values are sourced constants. Validation belongs to the chemoreceptor model it drives.
